numbers.SPEED: On one GPU (NVIDIA L40S) the full pipeline takes 1.0~s per 2048$\times$2048 image (5 minutes for the 180 test images, model loading included). Run from the repository weights in a fresh environment, it reproduces the submitted file: 1,214 of 1,214 submitted instances are matched, with a mean IoU of 0.9995 (1,091 masks are identical; the rest differ by a few boundary pixels because of GPU arithmetic). The rerun holds 2 additional instances whose keep value lies at the threshold. On a CPU it takes about 50~s per image.
